issues.description: Conflicting definitions for FIX_LEN and the fix_t typedef: example_program/src/math_fix.c unconditionally defines FIX_LEN as 8 and declares fix_t/fixu_t typedefs, whereas example_program/src/math_fix.h defines FIX_LEN conditionally and provides typedefs that depend on FIX_LEN. This creates a structural inconsistency: changing FIX_LEN in the header will not affect math_fix.c (because it forces FIX_LEN=8 and its own typedefs), which can confuse students and lead to mismatched types or unexpected behaviour when attempting to switch fixed-point width.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the typedef/FIX_LEN source of truth. Remove the hardcoded #define FIX_LEN and the duplicate typedefs from example_program/src/math_fix.c and instead include example_program/src/math_fix.h so the typedefs follow the header's FIX_LEN configuration. Alternatively, guard the math_fix.c definitions with #ifndef FIX_LEN and include the header to ensure both translation units use the same FIX_LEN and fix_t definitions.
